protocol.question: Does multi-horizon, volatility-scaled trend beat the frozen 30d absolute-momentum rule on BTC/ETH, traded the way the bot will trade?

data.note: Evaluation uses these saved files only; no re-download

protocol.decisions: Monday 00:00 UTC, completed daily candles only
protocol.execution: From 00:05 UTC, first minute at which both coins have a completed positive-volume 1-minute candle started at most 5 minutes earlier; fill at those closes; by 01:00 at the latest (house convention)

signal.rule: slot x fraction of lookbacks with positive trailing return x min(1, target_vol / 30-day realised vol); remainder GBP cash; weight changes smaller than the band are not traded

sweep.no_cap_implementation: target_volatility=None is run as 10.0, which never binds

periods.evaluation_status: 2024-2026 was already examined by crypto_momentum for the 30d rule; no C1 configuration has been evaluated on it
periods.true_holdout: Forward paper trading from the freeze date

selection.method: Annual, expanding window from first_decision to 1 January of the year being traded
selection.score: Net Sharpe, 0% cash, 365-day annualisation, rounded to 3 dp
selection.ties: Lower annualised turnover, then earlier in sweep order

benchmarks.primary: Frozen 30d absolute momentum (trend_absolute_30d), same universe, same within-the-hour execution and costs

costs.primary: 9bp fee + 3.5bp slippage per side on net traded weight (signal_factory 'pessimistic')
costs.later: Re-run with measured per-pair costs once crypto_execution publishes (earliest 2026-10-21)

cash.sensitivity: 3.75% constant (current Bank Rate), representing an off-exchange sweep

inference.statistic: Net Sharpe of the walk-forward C1 portfolio minus net Sharpe of the primary benchmark, 2024-01-01 to evaluation end
inference.method: Paired circular block bootstrap of daily net returns, 10,000 resamples, seed 20260924
inference.edge_rule: Two-sided 95% interval lower bound above zero
inference.power_note: About 2.7 evaluation years; a modest real improvement is unlikely to pass. Also report yearly wins against the benchmark, maximum drawdown and turnover

reporting: Number of weeks with any trade (proxy for disposals)
protocol.tax: Not modelled. Tax is paid only on realised gains; weekly trading realises them earlier than buy-and-hold, which is noted as a limitation
protocol.changes: Any change after freezing goes in protocol_v2 with its reason; this file is never edited
